scope: Offline stock GPU/APU integration trace; application reviews and performance claims excluded.

evidence.behavior: Typed ioctl dispatch with userspace copies and version handshake.
Serialized one-time firmware initialization, power-context active/idle pairing and error cleanup.
Optional DT firmware-name override, request_firmware, header and record validation, release_firmware.

platform.interpretation: Matched bit-3 path delegates these operations to secure firmware. rproc_alloc names mrv.elf, but that alone does not establish a filesystem firmware dependency. The legacy mdla_boot.bin/mdla_main.bin loader is not proof of the active MT6993 path.

interfaces: APUWare APUSYS HIDL 2.0/2.1 and AIDL V5
APUWare Utils HIDL 1.0/2.0 and AIDL V1
MediaTek neuronservice and neural-network shim services

access_boundary: Device-node DAC modes do not bypass SELinux.
Public native-library exposure, linker namespace access, Binder service discovery and device access are separate gates.
Applications targeting Android 12 or newer must declare required public native libraries.
The APU SDK adapter and offline Neuron runtime are different APIs; their versions are not interchangeable.
implementation: Validate complete NPU library inventory, public-list boundary and installation, prebuilt source/stem/ABI/partition, product selection, exact blob hashes and adapter SONAME.
limitations: No current-device tests or model benchmarks in this review.
No claim that every application uses GPU/APU or avoids CPU fallback.
Secure-world APU firmware internals and complete ioctl semantics are not reconstructed.
Keep matched kernel modules, DT, GPU firmware, vendor drivers and secure firmware together.
